editor-default.note: live preview, camera at origin, zoom 1

editor-panned-zoomed.note: live preview, panned off-origin at a fractional zoom

export-1920x1080.note: offscreen export path — viewportRect is exactly the video frame, so effective zoom === camZoom

root-id-zero.note: child with parentId === 0 — the falsy-zero branch in computeAllWorldTransforms

negative-scale-flip.note: bone scaleX < 0 and attachment scaleY < 0 — flipX/flipY about the attachment pivot

mesh-weighted.note: skinVertex weight blending incl. zero/unknown/short weight lists

mesh-unweighted.note: mesh with undefined vertexWeights — rigid fallback, negative bone scaleX

rotation-beyond-360.note: _wrot accumulates unnormalised degrees — must not be re-derived via atan2

deep-chain-ordered.note: 7-level chain, parents before children — current code already correct

deep-chain-shuffled.note: 7-level chain, children before parents — exceeds the 5-pass budget (known latent bug)

orphan-dangling-parent.note: bone whose parent was deleted — legacy freezes it at stale world values (known latent bug)

draw-order.note: renderer draw sequence: bone array order outside, slot array order inside

draw-order-array-vs-draworder.note: slot array order deliberately disagrees with drawOrder — pins which one the renderer follows
